description: Client-side script for the 'Issue' doctype in ERPNext, handling form load, UI interactions, and custom actions like resetting SLA, splitting issues, and managing timeline buttons.

classes.name: frappe.ui.Dialog
classes.description: Dialog class used for resetting SLA

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initializes form fields, sets queries, and adds buttons based on issue status.

methods.name: reset_service_level_agreement
methods.description: Opens a dialog to reset the SLA with a reason, then calls the reset function and refreshes the form.

methods.name: timeline_refresh
methods.description: Adds 'Split Issue' button to the timeline, handles its click event to split issues, and manages timeline UI elements.
